video_title: Hawks vs. Thunder Postgame Press Conference: Quin Snyder

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on the performance of young Hawks players
quotes.excerpt: young players as a team looking to play together.
quotes.quote: I think there was young players as a team looking to play together. I think for one thing, we saw that late in the game. And really when we started the game, I thought we were really good in transition, particularly after makes where guys were spaced, they were looking for each other, making really good reads.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder praised the Hawks young players for their chemistry and transition play late in the game saying they were looking for each other and making really good reads

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on integrating defensive rim protection
quotes.excerpt: Mara obviously is a factor at the rim and took us a little while to adjust to that.
quotes.quote: Mara obviously is a factor at the rim and took us a little while to adjust to that, which is good. You know, we're going to see shot blockers and going in there and just having a presence, having to read someone like that who has a presence at the rim. Lots of good things that we saw.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder noted the Hawks had to adjust to the rim protection they faced tonight saying having a presence at the rim is something they need to learn to read

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on Kobe Bufkin, A.J. Griffin, and Rayan Rupert
quotes.excerpt: Kobe had some big offensive rebounds late and A.J. and RayJ kind of finished it off.
quotes.quote: Kobe had some big offensive rebounds late and A.J. and RayJ kind of finished it off. Kobe defensively, and as you said, on the offensive boards, those are big plays, those are winning plays. And I think you see RayJ and A.J. really have a feel for one another. Also good to see. They put us in some situations defensively, Mara is a passer, that was a little bit different and they really executed well, which was good for us.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder highlighted the impact of Kobe Bufkin AJ Griffin and Rayan Rupert calling their late game efforts winning plays

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on Kobe Bufkin's development and process
quotes.excerpt: he continues to have a feel for what's going on in the game, when to shoot, when to pass.
quotes.quote: The word process is one that we felt you saw that over the course of the summer and I think he continues to have a feel for what's going on in the game, whether when to shoot, when to pass. But I think right now, from the last game too, he had a better presence on the ball and using his quickness and athleticism defensively, and that was part of the process, getting him in situations where he could really defend and have an impact, but not foul. So we saw that tonight.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder says Kobe Bufkin is showing better presence on the ball and using his athleticism defensively without fouling as part of his ongoing development
